definition: Lane is present in the active runtime and can process bars.
Lane has runtime presence plus a usable completed-bar timestamp and is not effectively stale.
Lane is loaded and not halted, faulted, reconciling, or entry-disabled.
Lane has an allowed runtime route, either broker-path or explicitly local/internal.
Lane is loaded, governed, route-ready, and inside its allowed session.
Lane is session-eligible but between completed decision bars.
Lane has an audit verdict other than insufficient history.
Lane was evaluated on the latest decision bar and no setup was present.
Lane currently has BUY/SELL/EXIT intent on a completed decision bar and all gates pass.
Lane is blocked by a real operational fault, stale-runtime effective block, data block, route block, or similar hard blocker.
Lane is eligible on the exact current completed decision bar.
